channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Assam Congress leaders attend ‘vote chori’ protest in Delhi, target BJP-led Centre
item.description: Gaurav Gogoi said the rally’s turnout reflected rising concern over democratic institutions & electoral integrity

item.title: Arunachal crash: Tinsukia police arrest two as SIT takes over probe
item.description: Tinsukia Zilla Parishad Deputy Chairperson said bodies of another 11 workers will be returned after post-mortem examinations on Sunday

item.title: Arunachal’s Pasighat, Itanagar set for panchayat, civic polls on Dec 15
item.description: Upper Subansiri district has the highest number of panchayat voters at 58,764, while Dibang Valley has the lowest at 3,854 electors

item.title: Sansad Kriya Mahotsav to kick off in Jorhat on Dec 21, says MoS Margherita
item.description: The four-day MP Sports Festival will span Majuli, Charaideo, Sivasagar & Jorhat, featuring athletics, kabaddi & sports

item.title: Mizoram, Assam agree to work together to boost tourism
item.description: The Mizoram Tourism Minister also requested that images and video visuals promoting Mizoram be showcased during major tourism events organised by Assam.

item.title: Veteran journalist & Assam Tribune Chairman Emeritus Prafulla Govinda Baruah no more
item.description: Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal, and the All Assam Students' Union have condoled the death of Baruah.

item.title: New Bornagar power hub to cut Northeast’s dependence on Bongaigaon substation
item.description: Officials say this concentration poses a systemic risk, as any disruption at Bongaigaon, located in a flood-prone zone could severely affect power supply across NE, particularly in Assam.

item.title: EVM-VVPAT first-level checking begins in Dhubri, Silchar for 2026 polls
item.description: In total, 1,939 ballot units (BUs), 2,094 control units (CUs) and 2,094 VVPATs are undergoing mandatory technical verification in Gauripur.

item.title: Night raids by wild elephants leave trail of ruin in Palasbari, Rani farmlands
item.description: Villagers have been lighting fires, beating tin sheets, bursting crackers, and keeping nightlong vigil to drive the elephants away, but these measures have failed to prevent repeated incursions.

item.title: 34 BJP MLAs, including 4 Kuki members, attend Delhi meet amid elected govt push
item.description: The meeting, which lasted from 5.30 pm to 7 pm, was chaired by B.L. Santhosh & Sambit Patra
